description: Defines classes for Mobile Country Code (MCC), Mobile Network Code (MNC), and PLMN identity, including conversion methods, operators, and string representations.

classes.name: mobile_country_code
classes.description: Represents a Mobile Country Code (MCC) with conversion and comparison methods.

classes.name: mobile_network_code
classes.description: Represents a Mobile Network Code (MNC) with conversion and comparison methods.

classes.name: plmn_identity
classes.description: Represents a Public Land Mobile Network (PLMN) identity, combining MCC and MNC, with conversion and comparison methods.

methods.name: test_value
methods.description: Returns a test value for MCC or MNC.

methods.name: from_bcd
methods.description: Converts a BCD-encoded integer to the respective code object.

methods.name: from_string
methods.description: Converts a string representation to the respective code object.

methods.name: from_bytes
methods.description: Converts a byte array to the respective code object.

methods.name: mcc
methods.description: Returns the MCC as a mobile_country_code object.

methods.name: mnc
methods.description: Returns the MNC as a mobile_network_code object.
